articles.title: Farewell to the Fluid Science Laboratory after 18 years in orbit
articles.summary: On 9 October, astronauts on the International Space Station begin supporting the final decommissioning of ESA's Fluid Science Laboratory (FSL), one of the longest-serving scientific facilities inside Europe's Columbus laboratory.
